checks.run: sha=$MOOR_PULL_HEAD_SHA; r=$MOOR_PULL_REPO; ids=$(gh api --paginate repos/$r/issues/$MOOR_PULL_NUMBER/comments --jq ".[]|select(.body|startswith(\"<!-- moor-evidence sha=$sha -->\"))|.id") || { echo "cannot read the comments of $r#$MOOR_PULL_NUMBER"; exit 1; }; n=$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -c . || true); [ "$n" = 1 ] || { echo "want 1 moor-evidence comment for $sha, found $n"; exit 1; };
checks.says: The pull request has exactly one evidence comment for this commit.

outcomes.name: check failed
outcomes.says: The pull request's check failed, by moor's own rerun and by the posted status.

checks.run: s=$(gh api repos/$MOOR_PULL_REPO/commits/$MOOR_PULL_HEAD_SHA/statuses --jq '[.[]|select(.context=="moor/evidence")][0].state') || { echo "cannot read the statuses of $MOOR_PULL_HEAD_SHA"; exit 2; }; echo "the newest moor/evidence status is ${s:-none}"; [ "$s" = failure ]
checks.says: The newest moor/evidence status on the head is failure.

checks.run: [ -n "${PR_RERUN:-}" ] || { echo "no PR_RERUN in env: moor cannot rerun the check"; exit 2; }; bash -c "$PR_RERUN"; rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 1 ] || { [ "$rc" = 0 ] || echo "the rerun did not run the check (exit $rc)"; exit 1; }
checks.says: moor's own rerun of the check at the head ran and failed.

outcomes.name: check passed
outcomes.says: The pull request's check passed, by moor's own rerun and by the posted status.

checks.run: s=$(gh api repos/$MOOR_PULL_REPO/commits/$MOOR_PULL_HEAD_SHA/statuses --jq '[.[]|select(.context=="moor/evidence")][0].state') || { echo "cannot read the statuses of $MOOR_PULL_HEAD_SHA"; exit 2; }; echo "the newest moor/evidence status is ${s:-none}"; [ "$s" = success ]
checks.says: The newest moor/evidence status on the head is success.

checks.run: [ -n "${PR_RERUN:-}" ] || { echo "no PR_RERUN in env: moor cannot rerun the check"; exit 2; }; bash -c "$PR_RERUN"
checks.says: moor's own rerun of the check at the head passed.

outcomes.name: nothing to do
outcomes.says: The pull request is closed, moved on, or not named.

checks.run: [ -n "$MOOR_PULL_NUMBER" ] || { echo "no pull request in env"; exit 0; }; got=$(gh api repos/$MOOR_PULL_REPO/pulls/$MOOR_PULL_NUMBER --jq '.state+" "+.head.sha') || { echo "cannot read the pull request"; exit 2; }; set -- $got; [ "$1" = open ] || { echo "the pull request is $1"; exit 0; }; [ "$2" = "$MOOR_PULL_HEAD_SHA" ] || { echo "its head moved to $2"; exit 0; }; echo "the pull request is open at $2"; exit 1
checks.says: There is no open pull request at the head this run was fired for.
